article.title: Terminación coloquial -(으)ㄹ걸요
article.part: Discurso académico y conversación — 학술 담화와 회화
article.chapter: Terminaciones coloquiales y conversación avanzada — 구어 종결형과 고급 회화

claims.summary: The colloquial termination -(으)ㄹ걸요 expresses conjecture, expectation, or polite correction based on what the speaker considers probable.
The form is added to the predicate using -(으)ㄹ걸요, with variations depending on the preceding consonant or vowel, and the 요 particle adds courtesy to the modal probability.

Several examples are given to illustrate the usage of -(으)ㄹ걸요 in different contexts, such as expressing a conjecture about a past event, an inference about someone's knowledge, an expectation about the future, and a polite correction of an expectation.
